title: Blair Mod
description: A grindy, god-filled overhaul that transforms Minecraft into a relentless battle for power and divinity.
body:
The Blair Mod completely reshapes Minecraft into a brutal, grind-heavy experience built around divine power and overwhelming challenges.

🛠️ Drastic Progression Overhaul – Every step forward demands time, resources, and strategy. Survival is no longer simple — it’s a trial of endurance.

👑 Gods & Lore – Encounter towering deities and lore-rich entities that dominate the world. Some may aid you, but most will crush the unworthy.

⚡ Overpowered Bosses & Beings – Battle mythic creatures with devastating abilities, each requiring preparation, persistence, and raw power to defeat.

🔮 Artifacts & Ascension – Unlock godlike tools and abilities by grinding through trials, crafting legendary items, and climbing the ladder of divinity.

🌍 A New World Order – The familiar Minecraft landscape is reimagined as a realm of divine struggle, where mortals fight for survival in the shadow of gods.

Are you strong enough to rise from nothing… and challenge the divine?
